ops.text: (c) HDI represents and warrants to the Company that: (1) the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting services performed by HDI under this Agreement (the "Services") will be performed in a professional manner and in a workmanlike manner, and for 90 days following performance of the Services the Services will conform to their documentation; (2) for 12 months following delivery, each deliverable and each item of software provided by HDI, including the Site, will conform to its documentation; (3) HDI will perform the Services in compliance with all applicable laws; and (4) the Site and any software or other materials provided by HDI will not contain any virus, worm, disabling device or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this Section 9(c) is repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid to HDI for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives only mutual authority warranties, so HDI stands behind none of the development or hosting work it is paid to perform. We have inserted our preferred performance warranty - professional and workmanlike Services with a 90-day Services period from performance, 12-month software and deliverable conformance to documentation, legal compliance and no malicious code, with repair, replacement or refund.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 9(c): HDI performance warranty with professional and workmanlike Services (90 days from performance), 12-month conformance of software and deliverables to documentation, compliance with laws and no malicious code, remedied by repair, replacement or refund.
